summary: Avino Silver & Gold Mines Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on April 23, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing Q1 2026 production results. The release reports quarterly production of 263,057 silver ounces, 1,851 gold ounces, and 1,343,654 pounds of copper, totaling 568,112 silver equivalent ounces. It highlights a year-over-year increase in mill throughput and steady progress at the La Preciosa development. There are no transaction terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics related to a special situation. The filing is purely operational, reporting routine production metrics without any corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring.
